- **Charcoal_Stalk_Rot**: Internal cross-section with black tissue - no match.
- **Fusarium/Gibberella**: Ear rot on cobs - different plant part entirely.
- **Physoderma_Stalk_Rot**: Green stalk with dense dark banding - different color and pattern.
- **Anthracnose**: Dark brown shredding lesions - no match.
